meta.title: Bunkly — Create your digital welcome book
meta.description: Create an elegant digital welcome book for your holiday home, Airbnb or vacation rental.

hero.badge: Welcome books for Airbnb, holiday homes & campsites
hero.title: The welcome your guests <accent>deserve</accent>
hero.subtitle: Create a modern digital welcome book in 5 minutes. Shared via QR code, automatically translated, updated in real time.

how.title: Your welcome book is online in 3 steps
how.step1Desc: Free sign-up in 30 seconds. No credit card required.
how.step2Desc: WiFi, check-in, house rules, activities... each module takes just a few clicks.
how.step3Desc: Print the QR code or send the link. Your guests open the book right on their phone.

features.title: Everything to host like a pro
features.subtitle: A platform built for modern hosts who want to impress their guests.
features.f1Desc: WiFi, check-in, house rules, local activities, emergency contacts and much more.
features.f2Desc: French, English, Spanish, German, Italian. Automatic translation in one click.
features.f3Desc: Generated automatically. Print it, place it in your rental or send it out.
features.f4Desc: Edit your book and guests see the changes in real time. No more printing.
features.f5Desc: Track how often your welcome book is viewed. Understand your guests.
features.f6Desc: Multiple properties? Duplicate an existing book and adapt it in minutes.
features.f7Desc: Colors, cover photos, custom URL — your image, your brand.
features.f8Desc: Add addresses with Google Maps links. Restaurants, activities, shops.
features.f9Desc: An interface designed for the phone. Your guests browse like in a real app.

phone.title: A welcome book that feels like a real app
phone.desc: Your guests open the link or scan the QR code. They land on a modern mobile interface — cover photo, intuitive navigation, all the info at their fingertips.
phone.li1: Splash screen with photo and personalized message
phone.li4: Works on every phone, no installation needed

demo.title: See Bunkly in action
demo.subtitle: Create a complete welcome book in under 5 minutes

testimonials.title: What our hosts say
testimonials.t1Text: My guests love it! I used to send a 10-page PDF nobody read. Now they have everything on their phone and ask me half as many questions.
testimonials.t2Text: I have 3 different cottages. The duplication feature saved my life — I created the first book, duplicated it twice and adapted it in 10 minutes. Brilliant.
testimonials.t3Text: The automatic translation is stunning. We host Germans and Brits all summer long — no more manual translating. A real time-saver.
